reviews.name: JOBTOPGUN
reviews.note: Language menu lists only Thai, pricing and posting pages read. The copyright names Super Resume Co., Ltd. but no headquarters country is stated; the home page says only that the platform is a leading Thai job platform, which describes its market, not its headquarters.

reviews.note: Quem somos gives the 1999 start with founding partners named in the timeline. Footer names Vagas Tecnologia as operator but no parent or holding company. No feed, XML, API or integration text found on the pages read.

reviews.name: Wantedly
reviews.note: The try_page redirects (301) to lp.wantedly.com/visit/material/1, a page titled as a Wantedly service overview; it mentions pricing structure but states no fees. The home page gives the unlimited postings and zero success fee quote, so the business model is only partly stated.
